item.title: 'Daredevil: Born Again' premiere held in New York City ahead of new season on Disney+
item.description: Monday night was the big premiere in New York City ahead of the first episode on Tuesday.

item.title: Preliminary magnitude 7.6 earthquake strikes near Tonga in the South Pacific Ocean, USGS says
item.description: A strong preliminary magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck near Tonga in the South Pacific Ocean, prompting coastal evacuations but no wider tsunami warnings.

item.title: Senators consider deal to fund Homeland Security but not ICE enforcement as airport lines snarl
item.description: "All I can say is that the discussions have been very positive and productive, and hopefully headed in the right direction," said Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D.

item.title: Dog reunited with family 11 years after being stolen from backyard in Philadelphia
item.description: After more than decade apart, a dog that was stolen from a Philadelphia backyard was reunited with his family in an emotional and heartwarming moment.

item.title: Lanes reopened after overturned big rig blocks I-45 North southbound before Greens Road
item.description: Houston TranStar shows multiple lanes have been reopened along the North Freeway at Greens on Tuesday morning following the wreck.

item.title: Fog is possible in Houston Tuesday morning, cool down coming this weekend
item.description: Yeah, it's warm, but we do have a cooldown and some needed rain chances in sight.

item.title: Shelter-in-place lifted after explosion at Valero facility in Port Arthur, police say
item.description: According to Port Arthur police, residents in the city's west side were advised to shelter in place after an explosion occurred at a Valero facility.

item.title: SW Houston homeowner shoots 'bloodied' man who kicked down his door and forced entry, police say
item.description: Houston police say a man with blood on his head was running through the neighborhood with a masked man before he kicked in a door, forced entry, and was shot by the homeowner. According to authorities, the masked man is still at large.

item.title: Precinct 1 deputy injured in crash on IH-69 at Collingsworth, authorities confirm
item.description: Drivers could experience some traffic delays as crews work to clear the scene of a crash involving a Precinct 1 deputy and another vehicle on IH-69 at Collingsworth, authorities said.

item.title: Former Missouri City police officer found guilty in 2024 crash that killed three people
item.description: The former Missouri City police officer was found guilty of three counts of aggravated assault by a public servant in the deadly crash that killed three people in 2024.
